task.title: Report an Incident at NC State
task.shortdesc: Follow these steps to report an incident that happened at NC State or through its networks.

step.cmd: Gather the following information about the incident:

ul.li: Type of incident (select from the "Type of Incidents" list)
Date and time of the incident

General description of the event, including the following details if applicable:
Computer name
IP address of each computer involved
Logs from each computer involved
